title: Nine Hundred Words and One Mill
subtitle: 文章与物件 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文章与物件（社会服务与人际沟通·传媒与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文章与物件（社会服务与人际沟通·传媒与写作）　|　核心词汇：article　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 article 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1982 my mother wrote ① an article about the closure of a mill, nine hundred words, and it ran on page nine. The ② article, meaning the writing and not the thing it was about, was cut by a third and she said the cutting improved it; an article, she said, is the only thing you can finish and still not own. She said the mill closed in June anyway.

Every ③ article she ever wrote began with a person and ended with a number, and she said that was the only shape she knew. Their ④ article — the one with the photograph — sold nine copies and changed one mind; an article, my father said, is a letter written to people who have not asked. He said the one mind was his.

My grandmother used the word for the other thing and meant ⑤ an article of clothing, by which she meant the coat with the blue buttons. The ⑥ article, meaning the object and not the writing, is the only word that covers both a coat and a column; an article, my mother said, is either something you wear or something somebody reads, and the word does not care. She said her mother had never read one.

By 1984 the ⑦ article had been quoted twice and paid for once. The ⑧ article of the agreement they both signed in June said nine days and meant nine weeks; an article, my father said, is the smallest part of a promise that can be argued about separately. He said the arguing took eleven months.

The ⑨ article I remember is the one about the mill, which my grandmother kept in a drawer for nine years. An ⑩ article, my mother said in 1988, is the only writing that is read once and believed for a decade; every article, she said, is a fact that has agreed to be temporary. She said she was glad of that at the time.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 文章（一篇具体的文章）
B. n. 文章（指那篇文字本身，与它所写的事相对）
C. 固定搭配：an article of clothing 一件衣物
D. 固定搭配：write an article 写文章
E. n. 物件；东西（与文字相对）
G. n. 文章（抽象总称；泛指）
H. n. 文章（指被引用、被保留的那一篇）

items.q: an article about the closure of a mill
The article, meaning the writing and not the thing it was about
The article, meaning the object and not the writing
the article had been quoted twice
An article, my mother said in 1988

answers.why: write an article 意为“写文章”，1982 年母亲写了一篇关于一家磨坊关闭的文章，九百词，登在第九版。
article 指“那篇文字本身”，与它所写的事相对，文章被砍掉三分之一，她说砍得好。
article 为抽象总称，泛指“文章这类文字”，她写的每一篇文章都以一个人开头、以一个数字结尾。
article 意为“一篇具体的文章”，他们那篇配了照片的文章卖了九份，改变了一个人的想法。
an article of clothing 意为“一件衣物”，祖母说的是另一回事，她指的是那件蓝扣子的大衣。
article 意为“物件、东西”，与文字相对，它是唯一既指一件大衣又指一个专栏的词。
article 指被引用、被保留的那一篇，到 1984 年那篇文章被引用了两次，只付过一次稿费。
article 意为“条款、条目”，他们六月共同签的那份协议里有一条写的是九天，实际意思是九个星期。
article 指被保留下来的那一篇，我记得的是关于磨坊的那篇，祖母在抽屉里放了九年。
article 为抽象总称，母亲说文章是唯一被读一遍、却被相信十年的文字。
